parsed.rationale: Both `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeMessage` (line 28 in HLSPlayerMessages.swift) and `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeMessage` (line 29 in RadioPlayerMessages.swift) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Since the implementations are identical and neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `PlaybackMessage`) with a default `makeMessage()` implementation in a protocol extension, allowing both conforming types to drop their individual copies.
